experiments.title: Fibonacci–Lucas tower validator
experiments.summary: The validator merged in E47-Kartekeya PR #135, fetched byte-for-byte at a pinned main commit and run unmodified: census along the tower, D → 3/φ, quantum-tetrahedron invariants, selector identity, and the exact 125×125 integer Casimir (rank K = 78, dim ker K = 47).

experiments.title: Tower census at one index n
experiments.summary: For one tower index n (odd, 3 ∤ n): j, J, the multiplicities n(j) = Fₙ and n(J) = Fₙ₋₂ counted directly from the weight census of V_j ⊗ V_j ⊗ V_j, the kept dimension D, D/(2j+1)², its gap to 3/φ, and (for j ≤ 2) the exact integer Casimir and selector rank.

params.name: casimir
params.label: exact Casimir build
params.help: builds the (2j+1)³ integer Casimir and ranks K exactly; runs only when j ≤ 2 (n = 5)

experiments.title: Sweep the tower up to n_max
experiments.summary: Every tower member 5 ≤ n ≤ n_max with the full census, the approach of D/(2j+1)² to 3/φ (carried to n + 40 digits), and a strict-monotonicity check on the gap. Produces the limit plot.

params.name: n_max
params.label: n_max
params.help: largest tower index in the sweep (≤ 199)
